title: Understanding Linear Models
text: A linear model with respect to a parameter means that the model is linear in terms of that parameter. This means that the parameter appears in the model without being raised to a power, multiplied by another parameter, or involved in any non-linear operations like exponentiation or logarithms.

title: Analyzing the Given Model
text: Consider the model \( \hat{y}=\theta_1+\theta_1**{2}x_1 \). Is the parameter \( $$\theta_1$$ \) involved in any non-linear operations?

title: Identifying Non-linear Operations
text: In the expression \( \theta_1+\theta_1**{2}x_1 \), notice that \( $$\theta_1$$ \) is squared. Squaring is a non-linear operation. This affects whether the model is linear with respect to \( $$\theta_1$$ \).
